label: For "Coding Agent Sandbox and Permission Policy": Run coding agents inside isolated sandboxes with least-privilege, short-lived credentials and egress controls so agents can build and test code but cannot reach production or exfiltrate data. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Developer credentials for agents.
